subject: planner: use the original table stats to estimate NDV for index selection of IndexJoin (#63892)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent, focusing on `pkg/planner/core/index_join_path.go` plus minimal stats-loading context (`logical_datasource.go`, `stats.go`). The change switches IndexJoin probe-index NDV estimation from filtered `DataSource.StatsInfo()` to immutable unfiltered `DataSource.TableStats`, avoiding underestimation when residual filters are applied after double-read scanning; tests were updated/added for #63869. No Blocker/High issues found in correctness, SQL semantics, consistency, or concurrency. Checked later history on `upstream/master`: subsequent commits further refine IndexJoin index-selection heuristics, but nothing indicates a correctness bug requiring a fix to this commit.
